findings.finding: An effective ATM through Ladenburg Thalmann with $9.82m of capacity left (Supplement No. 8, filed 2026-09-24), about the entire market cap at $4.43 on ~1.95m shares, can sell into the 10-01 session. It is the only equity channel still open: CVP/Streeterville debt exchanges are blocked under Nasdaq 5635 until the 2026-11-06 vote, and the ELOC with C/M Capital cannot draw below its $16.50 floor until that same vote lowers it.
findings.mechanism_in_window: The ATM is effective and continuously drawable; the issuer has used it before ($4.90m in the prior 12 months, and this is its eighth supplement), so sales can happen in the 10-01 session itself. The company cannot fund itself any other way before 11-06, because both other equity channels are shut until the vote.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Since the 09-24 supplement went effective, the stock's recorded comparable falls went: 09-24 -20.76% then +9.07%; 09-28 -21.82% then -11.63%. Across September, 6 of 8 comparable falls were followed by another down close (baseline history block).
findings.why_not_priced: The fall prices the shares already issued. It does not price ATM supply still to come against a thin float. Today's ~$2.7m of turnover is less than a third of the remaining ATM capacity, so the company can go on supplying into any bounce. If the price already held this supply, a heavy-volume day would end with a bounce rather than a third straight large fall. Part of this is surely in the name's -2.88 median already, which is why it is sized below that median.
findings.independence: The PRER14A (filed 2026-09-29) confirms the other two channels are shut and that the ELOC floor is $16.50: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1585608/000119312526407517/d78419dprer14a.htm. It proposes a warrant repricing to $1.00 and a further 1-for-2 to 1-for-150 reverse split, which shows the company plans more issuance.
